newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania gets 187 mln litas investment in H1 '96.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania gets 187 mln litas investment in H1 '96.

text.p: Lithuania received 186.7 million litas of foreign direct investment (FDI) in the first half of 1996, the central bank said on Monday.
It said in its latest quarterly report that FDI in the first half of 1995 was 120 million litas.
Foreign direct investment is viewed as one of the areas where Lithuania lags its Baltic neighbours Latvia and Estonia.

The Lithuanian central bank also said that portfolio investment by foreigners came to 309.9 million litas in the first half of the year, of which 298.1 million litas was invested in Lithuanian Treasury bills.
The central bank also said that foreign loans in Lithuania came to 657.1 million litas in the first half but gave no comparative data for the same 1995 period.
It said that the country's total external debt by the end of the third quarter was $987 million.
